# Toastbyte Studios

> A small app studio based in Las Vegas, NV, building practical tools for outdoor enthusiasts, hikers, and the preparedness community.

## TOAST App

TOAST (Tactical Operations and Survival Toolkit) is an offline-first emergency preparedness and survival app for iOS and Android. It is built for hikers, preppers, and anyone who wants practical tools that work without a network connection.

### Features
- **Core Module**: Unit converter, weather tools, voice log
- **Navigation Module**: Offline maps, trail tracking, distance/duration logging
- **Communications Module**: Ham radio repeater directory (powered by RepeaterBook), emergency contacts
- **Reference Module**: Survival guides, first aid references, emergency procedures
- **Prepper Module**: Pantry expiration tracker, emergency supply checklists, BOB (bug-out bag) planner

### Pricing
- Free tier available
- One-time Pro unlock: $4.99 (Founding price), $7.99–$9.99 regular

### Status
Coming soon — available on iOS App Store and Google Play. Join the waitlist at https://toastbyte.studio/

## About the Developer

Jason Shprintz is a solo developer and ham radio operator (KK7WGB) based in Las Vegas, NV. TOAST is named after his Jack Russell Terrier, Toast.
